LESSON: ICT TOOLS IN COMMUNICATION

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
Strand: Communication in Pre-Technical Studies
Topic 2.3: ICT Tools in Communication
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 6

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers ICT Tools in Communication, part of Communication in Pre-Technical Studies in Grade 7 PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES.

Key inquiry question: How are ICT tools used in communication?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. brainstorm and present on the meaning and importance of ICT tools in communication,

2. use print or digital media to search for information on ICT tools used in communication (email, mobile phone, computers, video and web conferencing tools, social networking, and online collaboration) and present the findings,

3. communicate using ICT tools (send and receive; email, texts, calls, chats, audio, animations and video).

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. brainstorm and present on the meaning and importance of ICT tools in communication,
2. use print or digital media to search for information on ICT tools used in communication (email, mobile phone, computers, video and web conferencing tools, social networking, and online collaboration) and present the findings,
3. communicate using ICT tools (send and receive; email, texts, calls, chats, audio, animations and video).

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on ICT Tools in Communication together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and Collaboration: learner acquires speaking, writing, listening, and teamwork skills while brainstorming

and presenting on the meaning and importance of ICT tools in communication.

• Learning to Learn: learner acquires skills of organizing own learning and collaborating with others when using print or

digital media to search for information on ICT tools used in communication.

• Digital Literacy: learner develops skills of interacting with technology when using ICT tools to communicate.

Values:
• Respect: learner shows open-mindedness when brainstorming and presenting the meaning and importance of ICT tools in

communication.

• Responsibility: learner shows accountability when handling ICT tools to communicate.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Mental Health: learner develops emotional awareness to relate well with peers when brainstorming and presenting on the

meaning and importance of ICT tools in communication.

Link to other Subjects:

The learner is able to relate communication concepts to communication skills in English.
